meta.title: AI太假？3招去掉“塑料感”秒变真实照片
meta.title_en: Make AI Photos Look Real: 3 Prompt Tricks

scenes.context: 为什么AI做的图总能看出是AI？其实不是模型不行，很多时候是你的提示词太干净了。
sentences: AI images are easy to spot.
Overly clean prompts are the culprit.
paraphrase: AI images are easy to spot.
Overly clean prompts are the culprit.
scenes.speak: AI images are easy to spot. Overly clean prompts are the culprit.

scenes.context: 很多AI人物假，是因为整张脸被光照得太均匀，现实里的光一定有方向、明暗、高光和阴影。
sentences: 整张脸被光照得太均匀。
The face is lit too evenly.
Real light has direction, highlights, and shadows.
paraphrase: The face is lit too evenly.
用highlights and shadows换一种说法
Real light has direction, highlights, and shadows.
scenes.speak: The face is lit too evenly. Real light has direction, highlights, and shadows.

scenes.context: 提示词里加上对光影的描述，人物一旦有了明确光源，就不会像贴在背景上一样。
sentences: Add light-and-shadow words to the prompt.
人物不再像贴在背景上。
The subject no longer looks pasted on.
paraphrase: Add light-and-shadow words to the prompt.
The subject no longer looks pasted on.
scenes.speak: Add light-and-shadow words to the prompt. The subject no longer looks pasted on.

scenes.context: AI脸最容易假的地方是五官和皮肤太完美、有塑料感，提示词里可以加轻微瑕疵。
scenes.speak: Too-perfect skin looks plastic. Minor imperfections add realism.

scenes.context: 真实照片是镜头在真实空间里捕捉人物，加上前景遮挡和中景清晰、前景虚化更真实。
scenes.speak: Real photos have foreground occlusion. Blurred foreground adds depth.

scenes.context: 书架边缘、玻璃反光这些遮挡关系让画面更像真实街拍，而不是AI生成的图片。
sentences: 书架和玻璃反光更真实。
Bookshelves and glass reflections read as real.
记这三类提示词让AI不像AI。
Use these prompts to make AI undetectable.
paraphrase: Bookshelves and glass reflections read as real.
Use these prompts to make AI undetectable.
scenes.speak: Bookshelves and glass reflections read as real. Use these prompts to make AI undetectable.

practice: Overly clean prompts are the culprit.
Add light-and-shadow words to the prompt.
前景遮挡让画面更真实。
Foreground occlusion makes the shot feel real.
pitfalls: 太干净的光是塑料感来源
具体描述光的方向和明暗
具体描述才有真实光影
加前景遮挡和中景虚化
